# De Castroverde Law Group

> A Las Vegas-based personal injury law firm specializing in accident claims, medical malpractice, and wrongful death cases across Nevada.

De Castroverde Law Group is a family-owned Nevada personal injury law firm with experienced attorneys (Alex, Orlando, and Waldo) who have recovered hundreds of millions for clients. They serve Las Vegas and surrounding areas including Henderson, Reno, Boulder City, and Summerlin.

## Key Topics

- Personal Injury Law
- Las Vegas Attorney
- Car Accident Claims
- Wrongful Death

- Nevada Legal Services
- Truck Accidents
